nominations.basis: Probed with scripts/probe_candidate_pages.py: this page reads (4,398 readable chars, well above the floor) and the verifier's own label test returns LABELLED on the fragment "Law Library of Congress" in region content, which is this node's curated name exactly. It is the Law Library's own site, on a second loc.gov host. The previous pass recorded host_refuses_crawler because www.loc.gov answers this project's User-Agent with HTTP 403 on the Law Library's paths; I re-probed and the 403 is path-scoped, not host-scoped (www.loc.gov/research-centers/, /services-and-programs/ and /careers/ also 403, while www.loc.gov/, /about/, /about/general-information/ and /discover/ all read 200 and simply do not carry the full name). wwws.loc.gov serves the same unit's own pages and is not refused, so a page for this unit is reachable after all.
